annotations.grafana.app/message:
Added Country breakdown + Transport & ports rows (lab sections 2+3).
Country breakdown + Transport & ports rows; country queries match Geo Maps filters.

spec.description:
Designed to visualize flow data coming in from Kentik's Ktranslate open source flow collector.

Network lab dashboard (02). Interface bps uses ktranslate delta gauges: `(octets) * 8 / 60`.

spec.expression: SELECT A.device_name AS "Exporter", A.__value__ AS "Total Bytes", B.device_name AS "SNMP Device" FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON A.device_name = B.if_Address ORDER BY A.__value__ DESC LIMIT 100

spec.title: Top Flow Peer Locations
spec.description: Private IP's will not show on map. Country information is based on MaxMind GeoIP database

spec.title: Top Flow Local Locations
spec.description: Private IP's will not show on map. Country information is based on MaxMind GeoIP database

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by(network_local_address, network_peer_address, src_host, dst_host) (max_over_time(network_io_by_flow_bytes{device_name=~"${device_name:pipe}", network_local_address=~"${src_addr:pipe}", network_peer_address=~"${dst_addr:pipe}", src_host=~"${src_host:pipe}", dst_host=~"${dst_host:pipe}"}[$__range])))

topk(25, sum by(device_name, network_local_address, network_peer_address, src_host, dst_host, network_protocol_name) (max_over_time(network_io_by_flow_bytes{device_name=~"${device_name:pipe}", network_local_address=~"${src_addr:pipe}", network_peer_address=~"${dst_addr:pipe}", src_host=~"${src_host:pipe}", dst_host=~"${dst_host:pipe}"}[$__range])))

topk(25, sum by(device_name, network_local_address, network_peer_address, src_host, dst_host) (max_over_time(network_io_by_flow_bytes{device_name=~"${device_name:pipe}",network_local_address=~"${src_addr:pipe}",network_peer_address=~"${dst_addr:pipe}",src_host=~"${src_host:pipe}",dst_host=~"${dst_host:pipe}",network_protocol_name=~"${application:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Peer Destinations by Country
spec.description: Drill-down for Geo Maps: country, peer IP, and hostname. Same filters as Top Flow Peer Locations.

spec.expr: topk(25, sum by(network_peer_country, network_peer_address, dst_host) (max_over_time(network_io_by_flow_bytes{device_name=~"${device_name:pipe}",network_local_address=~"${src_addr:pipe}",network_peer_address=~"${dst_addr:pipe}",src_host=~"${src_host:pipe}",dst_host=~"${dst_host:pipe}",network_protocol_name=~"${application:pipe}",network_peer_country!~"Private IP|undefined"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Peer Country Traffic over Time
spec.description: Stacked bytes by peer country (excludes Private IP / undefined). Matches Geo Maps variable scope.

spec.title: Traffic by Transport
spec.description: TCP vs UDP share of flow bytes (all matched flows).

spec.title: Top Destination Ports
spec.description: Peer port and L7 application (ktranslate protocol name).

spec.expr: topk(25, sum by(device_name, network_local_address, network_peer_address, src_host, dst_host) (max_over_time(network_io_by_flow_bytes{device_name=~"${device_name:pipe}", network_local_address=~"${src_addr:pipe}", network_peer_address=~"${dst_addr:pipe}", src_host=~"${src_host:pipe}", dst_host=~"${dst_host:pipe}"}[$__range])))
